description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordListModel class in the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It models a list of attendance records with methods to serialize data into an array, utilizing helper traits for date/time and number formatting. It implements relevant interfaces for collection normalization and constructor argument awareness.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordListModel
classes.description: A model class representing a list of attendance records, capable of serializing its data into array format for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of attendance record data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the attendance records into a structured array with formatted date/time and duration, suitable for API output.
